dist.title: Angelo State - ASU Distinguished Scholarship (first-time students)

test_policy.notes: ACT or SAT scores are optional for international first-year applicants and for domestic applicants (test-optional policy); international freshmen need a qualifying score only to earn an ASU Distinguished Scholarship. The international page states no minimum scores.

requirements.notes: Apply through ApplyTexas ('own'); $50 non-refundable fee, no fee waivers for international applicants. Also needed: official high school transcript (and any college transcripts), a sponsor-completed Official Financial Statement with original signatures, an official bank statement in U.S. dollars, and English proficiency. Send documents as scanned PDFs to CIS@angelo.edu. After admission the I-20 is issued. TSI assessment (can be taken after arrival), meningitis vaccine and TB screening are required for enrollment, not admission. Domestic first-years are guaranteed admission by class rank/GPA/test (top 25%; next 25% with 2.5 GPA or 17 ACT / 920 SAT; third quarter with 2.7 GPA or 21 / 1060); the international page does not state a GPA or rank rule.

deadlines.label: Application (fall 2027): no undergraduate international deadline published
deadlines.notes: The undergraduate international and first-time student pages print no deadline. Angelo State's graduate program tables list international deadlines of Nov. 1 (spring), March 1 (summer) and June 10 (fall) but those are not stated for undergraduates; confirm with cis@angelo.edu / 325-942-2083 and allow time for the I-20 and visa. Exams should be taken at least 8 weeks before the deadline.

deadlines.label: ASU Distinguished Scholarship priority: be admitted by April 1 (fall 2027)
deadlines.notes: Students admitted by April 1 are reviewed automatically; later admits are reviewed as funds allow. No separate application. International freshmen must have a qualifying ACT/SAT score. The page shows the 2026-27 award table with no year on the date, so April 1, 2027 is assumed for fall 2027 entry.

english_policy.waiver_notes: Every applicant who is not a native English speaker must show English proficiency. The pages read list no test exemptions; certificates from ELS Educational Services (112) or a CEA-accredited English program are accepted with official transcripts and certification. Conditional admission: the ELLI (English Language Learners' Institute) application offers an 'English Only' or 'Conditional Admission into Angelo State University' option; ELLI is a non-credit 7-week-session program on campus ($3,108 tuition and fees per 7-week session, $5,176 per 14 weeks, plus a $50 application fee). The conditions for moving into a degree program are not stated on the pages read.

english.notes: Listed as 'iTOEFL' (internet-based). Paper-based TOEFL 550 is also listed. The page does not give the new 1-6 scale.
The table lists 'Pearsons' 60, read here as Pearson PTE Academic.
Table lists Cambridge B2, CAE C1 and CPE C2 as passing levels; no numeric score is given.

aid.notes: Every admitted student is automatically considered for the ASU Distinguished Scholarship (2026-27 table): $2,000/yr (ACT 21, SAT 1060-1090, top 40% or 3.25 GPA) up to $10,000/yr (ACT 34-36 or SAT 1490-1600 with 3.5 GPA), renewable over four years; international freshmen must have a qualifying ACT/SAT score. A scholarship of $1,000 or more makes the student eligible for in-state tuition rates (international SAT/ACT page). Angelo State says 60% of undergraduates receive a Distinguished Scholarship. From the Common Data Set: 13 nonresidents received aid from the college, average $8,347.
